test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Federalism in the Indian constitutional context means:

options.text: the existence of more than one level of government in the country
the existence only one level of government in the country
the existence of states in the country
the existence of one nation one government in the country

solution:
The correct answer is__** ​the existence of more than one level of government in the country.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the Indian constitutional context,** federalism** refers to a system of governance where power is **divided between a central authority (the Union government) and various regional entities (the State governments). **
 
• Indian federalism is unique and is often described as **"quasi-federal" **because it **combines both federal and unitary features. **
 
• While states have autonomy in certain areas, the** central government holds more power, especially in times of crisis or national interest.**
 
• The Constitution divides legislative, administrative, and financial powers between the Union and the States through** three lists **(**Union List** (central government powers), **State List **(state government powers) and** Concurrent List** (shared powers between the Union and the States) in the** Seventh Schedule.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Key Constitutional Articles**

 
• **Article 1**: Defines India as a Union of States.
 
• **Article 245-255**: Deals with the distribution of powers between the Union and the States.
 
• **Article 256**: Directs the States to comply with the laws made by the Union.
 
• **Article 256**: Provides for the appointment of a Governor for each state to act as a liaison between the State and the Union.
